Container.Name: keida-hub
Container.Overview: Keida Hub is a self-hosted dashboard for games, services, integrations, status, controls, and home-server tools.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Keida Hub configuration, database, and application state.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the Keida Hub web interface.

Config.Name: Discord Sign-In Enabled
Config.Description: Optional per-install Discord OAuth sign-in. Configure Client ID, Redirect URI, Guild ID, and the file-backed client secret before enabling.

Config.Name: Discord OAuth Client ID
Config.Description: Application ID from your own Discord application.

Config.Name: Discord OAuth Redirect URI
Config.Description: Exact Discord OAuth redirect URI for this Hub, normally https://your-hub.example/api/auth/discord/callback.

Config.Name: Discord Guild ID
Config.Description: Discord server ID whose members are allowed to sign in.
